evals.prompt: My Windows C drive has only 8 GB left. I use WSL2, Docker, VS Code, Codex and Claude Code. Please inspect it read-only and tell me whether WSL swap is actually the problem. Do not delete anything.
evals.expected_output: A standard audit report that uses the bundled scanner, distinguishes WSL ext4.vhdx from swap, reports Windows page file separately, and ranks cleanup candidates by risk.
expectations: No cleanup or destructive command is executed.
The report contains all nine required sections from references/report-format.md.
WSL VHDX, WSL swap, and Windows pagefile are treated as distinct items.
Sizes state whether they are logical, allocated, internally used, or estimates.

evals.prompt: C盘被开发环境占满了，帮我重点检查 vscode、codex、cc、npm、pnpm、uv、playwright 和浏览器缓存，输出统一格式并告诉我哪些可以重建。WSL 现在是停止状态，不要启动它。
evals.expected_output: A Chinese read-only report that keeps stopped WSL distributions stopped, inventories the named developer tools, identifies rebuildable caches, and highlights stateful data requiring review.
expectations: Stopped WSL distributions are not started.
The named developer tools are covered or explicitly reported as absent.
Rebuildable cache is separated from session, workspace, browser-site, and system data.
The output follows the standard report section order.

evals.prompt: Run a full audit of D: for a Windows profile mounted at D:\Profiles\dev. Include WSL runtime and Docker reclaimability, save both machine-readable JSON and a Markdown report, but only propose cleanup commands for later approval.
evals.expected_output: A Full-mode scan with custom drive/profile arguments and opt-in WSL runtime inspection, producing both JSON and Markdown without executing cleanup.
expectations: The scanner is invoked with the requested drive, profile root, Full mode, and WSL runtime flag.
Both JSON and Markdown outputs are produced or their output locations are clearly specified.
Docker values are described as reclaimability candidates rather than automatic deletion targets.
Cleanup commands remain proposals requiring approval.
